{"metadata":{"description":"LLM-as-a-Verifier for DeepSeek Harness: continuous reward signals via select / compare / track","id":"gh:1338852104","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-llm-verifier","slug":"uson1x/dsh-plugin-llm-verifier","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llm-as-a-verifier"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"LLM-as-a-Verifier for DeepSeek Harness: continuous reward signals via select / compare / track"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-llm-verifier"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds an **LLM verifier**: it grades candidate solutions with a mo"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"del and returns scores between 0 and 1. Based on LLM-as-a-Verifier (paper)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The headline feature is `verify_rollout`: ask for something once, and the plugin runs several indepe"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ndent agent attempts in parallel, grades them, and gives you the best one."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Requires Node 20+ and a working DeepSeek Harness profile. Install into the profile your dsh command "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"actually loads — `web` for `dsh web`, `headless` for the CLI:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Then **append** this entry to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the file is a YAML list and usually"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" already exists — add to it, don't replace it; examples/cordis.patch.yml is a copy with the most use"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ful options commented in):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"`provider` and `model` name the LLM route that does the grading — replace them with a provider and m"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"odel id your profile registers (the same names dsh's model picker shows). The plugin refuses to load"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"rofile registers (the same names dsh's model picker shows). The plugin refuses to load without them."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Restart dsh (patch files are read at boot). If the web app was already open in a browser tab, reload"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" the tab once so it picks up the plugin's UI bundle."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Smoke test:** ask the agent to *"use llm as a verifier to write a haiku"*. You should see a `verif"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"y_rollout` call fan out into subagents — and in the web app, a **Verifier** tab next to Chat and Tra"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"t` call fan out into subagents — and in the web app, a **Verifier** tab next to Chat and Trajectory."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**To update later:** re-run the `npm install github:…` command in the profile and restart dsh."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`verify_rollout` needs a subagent provider named `spawn` (present in stock dsh); the other three too"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"needs a subagent provider named `spawn` (present in stock dsh); the other three tools work anywhere."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Just talk to your agent. These all work:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> use llm as a verifier to write a landing page tagline"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> try this 5 times and keep the best: …"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> here are three drafts — pick the strongest one"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The plugin adds a short note to the system prompt so the agent knows to route phrases like these to "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"the right tool. You never have to name a tool."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Each attempt ("rollout") runs as a separate agent session. Open the parent conversation's subagent l"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ist (the tree icon in the header) to watch them run and read what each one did."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## The four tools"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `verify_rollout(task, n?, rollout_model?)` | Run `n` independent attempts (default 3, allowed 2–8)"},{"id":"p24s2","text":", grade them, return the winner |
| `verify_select(task, candidates[])` | You already have N candida"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"tes (at least 2); pick the best |
| `verify_compare(task, candidate_a, candidate_b)` | Compare exact"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ly two candidates |
| `verify_track(task, trajectory[])` | Score how much progress a step-by-step at"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"s |
| `verify_track(task, trajectory[])` | Score how much progress a step-by-step attempt has made |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Other plugins can call the same functions directly via `ctx.verifier` (`select`, `compare`, `track`,"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ins can call the same functions directly via `ctx.verifier` (`select`, `compare`, `track`, `score`)."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Web UI card"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"In the `dsh web` interface, `verify_rollout` renders as a rich card instead of a plain tool row: a s"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"coreboard with one reward bar per attempt, the winner highlighted, failed attempts with their stop r"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"eason, and an expandable preview of the winning deliverable. Each attempt is a real subagent session"},{"id":"p27s4","text":", so you can open any of them from the session's subagent list to read the full trajectory."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"No setup needed — the plugin ships its own client bundle (`./client` export) and dsh's web server pi"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"cks it up automatically. Headless/CLI use is unaffected."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### The Verifier tab"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Next to Chat and Trajectory, each session gets a **Verifier** tab — the deep-dive view of every `ver"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ify_rollout` run in that session. Per attempt: reward bar, wall-clock time, tool-call and turn count"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"s, how much trajectory the judge read, the attempt's own deliverable (not just the winner's), and an"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" "open" button that jumps into that rollout's session. A "how the judge decided" panel shows the cri"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"teria and repetition config plus every pairwise comparison the tournament ran. Runs still in flight "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"show up as "running"."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## How grading works"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"To grade a candidate, the plugin asks the model to rate it on the reference implementation's banded "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"20-point scale (20 = clearly succeeded with verified output, 11–13 = uncertain leaning success, 1 = "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"clearly failed, and so on). Every judge prompt also carries a ground-truth note reminding the model "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"that no reference solution exists. It does this several times, for several separate criteria, and av"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"erages everything into one score between 0 and 1:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **1–20 instead of 1–5** — a finer scale separates close candidates better.
- **Several repetitions"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"** (default 4) — averaging repeated grades reduces noise.
- **Several criteria** — small focused que"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"stions beat one big vague one. Text candidates (`verify_select` / `verify_compare`) default to the p"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"aper's 3 coding criteria (follows the spec / output is correct / no errors); full rollout trajectori"},{"id":"p33s5","text":"es default to the reference implementation's single **Task Success** criterion, which explicitly tel"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"ls the judge that trajectory length and confidence do not predict correctness.
- **Majority voting**"},{"id":"p33s7","text":" — when a strict majority of candidates are byte-identical, the tournament is skipped and the majori"},{"id":"p33s8","text":"ty answer wins outright."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"To pick the best of N candidates, it runs a small tournament instead of grading each in isolation:"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"1. Arrange the candidates in a random ring and grade each neighboring pair. Every candidate is seen "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"once as "A" and once as "B", which cancels the model's position bias.
2. Take the top 2 as "pivots"."},{"id":"p35s3","text":"
3. Grade everyone against the pivots.
4. Each pairwise result adds to a win score; the candidate wi"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"th the best win ratio wins."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"This is the paper's "Probabilistic Pivot Tournament". It needs at most `3(N−1)` pair gradings — fewe"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"r in practice, because ring pairs are reused in the tournament — instead of all `N(N−1)/2` pairs."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Everything has a sensible default except `provider` and `model`, which you must set — the plugin ref"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"uses to load without them."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
